description:
Returns the account IDs for the users specified in the `key` or `username` parameters. Note that multiple `key` or `username` parameters can be specified.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Permission to access Jira.

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: Username of a user. To specify multiple users, pass multiple copies of this parameter. For example, `username=fred&username=barney`. Required if `key` isn't provided. Cannot be provided if `key` is present.
parameters.name: username

parameters.description: Key of a user. To specify multiple users, pass multiple copies of this parameter. For example, `key=fred&key=barney`. Required if `username` isn't provided. Cannot be provided if `username` is present.
parameters.name: key

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.
